Your spaces

    Tours stay on this account until you create a handoff. A handoff is unlisted: it is not a public gallery, it is not indexed, and Revoke stops it working.

    Want this account and its records deleted? Ask for deletion — we reply from that address and confirm before anything is removed. Removing the account does not delete tours a client is still holding a live link to, so revoke those first.
